policy: Only dependencies with a verified upstream, immutable version, checksum, and compatible license may enter a release lockfile.

allowlist.name: FXServer
allowlist.notes: Downloaded by the operator. Requires an operator-owned Cfx license key.

allowlist.name: oxmysql
allowlist.notes: Installed from the official release archive pinned by up.lock.json.

allowlist.name: ox_lib
allowlist.notes: Evaluated dependency of the optional Ox provider. Install separately; never call undocumented internals from first-party resources.

allowlist.name: ox_inventory
allowlist.notes: Evaluated baseline only. The fork, UP bridge, adapter, notices, modification log and corresponding source stay in a separate GPL repository. Commercial distribution remains blocked on qualified legal review.

prohibited: real-world branded vehicles or unlicensed third-party IP
dependencies without an explicit redistribution grant
